title: Getting ready for the new app name
thisBuild: The app is moving to its permanent store ID, app.shotgunstudio.messmachine, before launch. This build only gets the old app ready to hand over your messes.
The next update installs as a new app next to this one. On its first launch it copies all your messes, Workbench sounds, packs and settings across by itself.
The engine now has a speed check in every build: it takes about 22 microseconds per sound block, the same as the old Java engine.
watch: Nothing should look or sound different from the last build.
limits: Keep this old app installed until the new one has opened once and says your messes moved over. Then you can uninstall the old one.
